_about: Store listing source of truth for Chrome Web Store, AMO and Edge Add-ons. Publishing itself is blocked on developer accounts (see Roadmap_Blocked.md); everything here is the asset and copy work, which is not. Kept as JSON rather than a doc because the repo's file-hygiene rule allows no new markdown files.

assets._note: Regenerate with: RUMBLEX_STORE_CAPTURE=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/store-assets.spec.js. That test re-reads every PNG from disk and asserts its exact pixel size, because a store rejects an off-by-one image at submission time.

permission_justifications._note: One entry per manifest permission. Chrome Web Store requires a justification for each, and flags broad host patterns plus anything facilitating video downloads for in-depth review. The narrow host list and the local-only storage claim are stated up front rather than buried.

api.storage: Stores the user's own settings, watch history, bookmarks and saved SponsorBlock segments in chrome.storage.local. Nothing is sent anywhere; scripts/check-manifest-privacy.js fails the build if a network sink is added to a path that reads this data.
api.unlimitedStorage: Prevents a large local SponsorBlock profile plus its bounded undo history from exceeding the browser's default extension-storage quota. Data stays on this device and the snapshot count remains user-controlled.
api.downloads: Saves a video the user explicitly asked to download, using the browser's own download manager so the file lands in the user's chosen directory and appears in chrome://downloads. No download is ever started without a click.
api.offscreen: MV3 service workers have no DOM, so muxing a downloaded HLS stream into MP4 runs in an offscreen document. It processes only bytes already fetched for the requested download and is torn down afterwards.
api.contextMenus: Adds RumbleX actions to the right-click menu on rumble.com pages and links (download, copy timestamped URL, block channel).
api.scripting: Injects the settings UI and feature code into rumble.com tabs that were already open when the extension was installed or updated, so the user does not have to reload every tab.
api.tabs: Reads the URL of the active rumble.com tab to decide which features apply (watch page, feed, channel, account) and to route a download request to the tab that made it. Tab contents are never read for any other host.
api.tabGroups: Groups the tabs opened by the Channel Archive queue so a batch of downloads does not scatter across the tab strip.
api.sidePanel: Optional side-panel view of the same options page, opened only when the user turns it on.
api.alarms: Re-arms the archive queue and settings-snapshot timers across service-worker restarts. MV3 terminates the worker aggressively and setTimeout does not survive that.
api.notifications: Reports the completion or failure of a long download or an archive batch, which can outlive the page the user started it from.
api.declarativeNetRequest: Blocks Rumble's ad and tracking requests using seven static rules scoped to Rumble-owned hosts. Declarative rather than blocking webRequest, so the extension never sees the contents of any request.

host.*://*.rumble.com/*: The site the extension exists to modify. Every feature is scoped to it.
host.*://*.1a-1791.com/*: Rumble's media CDN. Needed to read the media manifest for a download the user requested, and to match the ad rules that Rumble serves from this host.
host.*://*.rumble.cloud/*: Rumble's other media CDN (hugh.cdn.rumble.cloud). Same purpose as above.
host.https://api.github.com/*: Requested only when a user clicks the update check or an encrypted Gist action. If access is denied, no GitHub request is sent.

firefox_api.storage: Stores settings and the user's local RumbleX activity in extension storage. Nothing is sent anywhere.
firefox_api.unlimitedStorage: Prevents large local settings profiles and their bounded undo snapshots from failing at Firefox's default extension-storage quota. Data stays on this device.
firefox_api.downloads: Saves a video only after the user starts a download.
firefox_api.contextMenus: Adds RumbleX actions to the context menu on Rumble pages and links.
firefox_api.alarms: Resumes archive and snapshot timers after Firefox restarts the background page.
firefox_api.notifications: Reports completion or failure for downloads and archive batches that can outlive their starting tab.
firefox_api.webRequest: Lets the Firefox MV2 build identify requests to the listed Rumble ad hosts so its blocking listener can decide whether they match the fixed deny list.
firefox_api.webRequestBlocking: Lets the Firefox MV2 build cancel only requests that match the fixed Rumble ad-host deny list. Request bodies are never read.

firefox_host.*://a.ads.rmbl.ws/*: Rumble ad delivery host blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://imasdk.googleapis.com/*: Video ad SDK host used by Rumble and blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://s0.2mdn.net/*: Video ad asset host used by Rumble and blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/*: Ad measurement host used by Rumble and blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://*.doubleclick.net/*: Ad delivery and measurement hosts used by Rumble and blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://*.googleadservices.com/*: Ad measurement hosts used by Rumble and blocked by the Firefox MV2 request listener.
firefox_host.*://*.1a-1791.com/*: Rumble media CDN used for playback metadata and user-requested downloads.
firefox_host.*://*.rumble.cloud/*: Rumble media CDN used for playback metadata and user-requested downloads.
firefox_host.https://api.github.com/*: Optional access requested only for a user-started update check or encrypted Gist action.

not_requested._note: Worth stating in the listing: the permissions a reviewer might expect and will not find, with browser differences named explicitly.
not_requested.<all_urls>: Never requested. Both manifests list every site they can reach.
not_requested.Chromium webRequest / webRequestBlocking: Never requested by Chrome, Edge or Brave. Those browsers use declarativeNetRequest. Firefox MV2 requests both APIs for the fixed ad-host list above.
not_requested.identity / cookies / history / bookmarks: Never requested. RumbleX keeps its own local history and bookmarks and does not touch the browser's.

copy._note: CWS caps the short description at 132 characters. Localizing name/short/detailed description measurably improves ranking in each locale, so one entry ships per locale. check-store-listing.js derives that list rather than hardcoding it.

en.name: RumbleX
en.short_description: Make Rumble yours with ad blocking, downloads, Theater Split, seven themes, and 140+ controls. No telemetry.
en.detailed_description:
Make Rumble fit the way you watch. RumbleX is an open-source control layer with 141 focused modules, from a calmer feed to serious media tools. Choose what you want and leave the rest off.

WATCH WITHOUT THE CLUTTER
Scoped browser rules block known Rumble ad and tracking hosts before the page loads. Page cleanup removes pause overlays, premium prompts, sponsored cards, Shorts, and the empty space they leave behind.

BUILD A BETTER PLAYER
Theater Split puts video beside live chat, comments, or downloads. Add persistent speed and volume, chapters, transcripts, SponsorBlock, per-channel preferences, a mini player, and one of seven complete site themes.

SAVE WHAT YOU CHOSE TO WATCH
Download direct MP4, convert HLS to MP4, save a raw stream, export a clip, batch-select a feed, or queue a channel. When a download fails, RumbleX identifies the failed stage and gives you a useful next step.

TAKE CONTROL OF CHAT AND COMMENTS
Keep paid messages visible, block noisy users, remove repeated spam, highlight keywords, sort comments, and export conversations as local files.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
RumbleX has no telemetry, remote configuration, or account. Settings, watch activity, bookmarks, diagnostics, and undo snapshots stay in local browser storage. The built-in Privacy Report explains every permission and network destination in plain language. Optional GitHub access is requested only when you start an update check or encrypted Gist action.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.

de.name: RumbleX
de.short_description: Werbeblocker, Video-Downloads und über 140 Layout- und Player-Optionen für rumble.com. Keine Telemetrie, alles lokal.
de.detailed_description:
RumbleX ist eine quelloffene Erweiterung, die dir die Kontrolle über rumble.com gibt.

WERBEBLOCKER
Sieben deklarative Netzwerkregeln blockieren Rumbles Werbe- und Tracking-Hosts, bevor die Seite lädt, ergänzt durch DOM-Bereinigung für Pause-Overlays und Premium-Hinweise.

DOWNLOADS
Speichere ein Video als direkte MP4-Datei, wandle einen HLS-Stream in MP4 um oder schreibe den rohen Transportstream direkt in eine Datei deiner Wahl. Wähle mehrere Videos aus einem Feed aus oder exportiere einen Clip zwischen zwei Markierungen.

PLAYER UND LAYOUT
Über 140 Optionen: geteilter Kinomodus, sieben vollständige Website-Themes, drei Anzeigedichten, optionale Umgebungsfarbe am Player, dauerhafte Wiedergabegeschwindigkeit, Lautstärke per Mausrad und ein Mini-Player.

KOMMENTARE UND CHAT
Kommentar-Navigation und -Sortierung, Export als JSON oder CSV, Blockieren einzelner Chat-Nutzer, Entfernen doppelter Spam-Nachrichten und Rants, die über ihren Ablauf hinaus sichtbar bleiben.

DATENSCHUTZ
RumbleX sammelt nichts. Keine Analyse, keine Fernkonfiguration, kein Konto. Deine Einstellungen, dein Wiedergabeverlauf und deine Lesezeichen liegen im lokalen Browserspeicher und verlassen das Gerät nie. Der eingebaute Datenschutzbericht zeigt genau, welche Hosts die Erweiterung erreichen kann und warum. Unter Chromium ist der Zugriff auf Rumble, seine zwei Medien-CDNs und optionale GitHub-Aktionen begrenzt. Firefox führt zusätzlich die einzelnen Werbe-Hosts auf, die seine Blocking-API benötigt.

Verfügbar auf Englisch, Deutsch, Spanisch, Französisch, Italienisch und brasilianischem Portugiesisch.

es.name: RumbleX
es.short_description: Bloqueo de anuncios, descargas y más de 140 controles de diseño y reproductor para rumble.com. Sin telemetría.
es.detailed_description:
RumbleX es una extensión de código abierto que te da el control de rumble.com.

BLOQUEO DE ANUNCIOS
Siete reglas de red declarativas bloquean los servidores de anuncios y rastreo de Rumble antes de que cargue la página, con limpieza del DOM para las superposiciones de pausa y los avisos de Premium.

DESCARGAS
Guarda un vídeo como MP4 directo, convierte un flujo HLS a MP4, o escribe el flujo de transporte sin procesar directamente en el archivo que elijas. Selecciona varios vídeos de cualquier feed o exporta un clip entre dos marcas.

REPRODUCTOR Y DISEÑO
Más de 140 controles: modo cine dividido, siete temas completos, tres densidades de visualización, color ambiental opcional para el reproductor, velocidad persistente, volumen con la rueda y un minirreproductor.

COMENTARIOS Y CHAT
Navegación y ordenación de comentarios, exportación a JSON o CSV, bloqueo de usuarios del chat, eliminación de spam duplicado y rants que siguen visibles tras caducar.

PRIVACIDAD
RumbleX no recopila nada. No hay analíticas, ni configuración remota, ni cuenta. Tus ajustes, tu historial y tus marcadores viven en el almacenamiento local del navegador y nunca salen del equipo. El informe de privacidad integrado muestra exactamente a qué servidores puede llegar la extensión y por qué. En Chromium, el acceso se limita a Rumble, sus dos CDN multimedia y las acciones opcionales de GitHub. Firefox también enumera los servidores de anuncios que necesita su API de bloqueo.

Disponible en inglés, alemán, español, francés, italiano y portugués de Brasil.

pt_BR.name: RumbleX
pt_BR.short_description: Bloqueio de anúncios, downloads e mais de 140 controles de layout e player para o rumble.com. Sem telemetria.
pt_BR.detailed_description:
O RumbleX é uma extensão de código aberto que dá a você o controle do rumble.com.

BLOQUEIO DE ANÚNCIOS
Sete regras de rede declarativas bloqueiam os servidores de anúncio e rastreamento do Rumble antes de a página carregar, com limpeza do DOM para as sobreposições de pausa e os avisos do Premium.

DOWNLOADS
Salve um vídeo como MP4 direto, converta um fluxo HLS em MP4 ou grave o transport stream bruto direto no arquivo que você escolher. Selecione vários vídeos de qualquer feed ou exporte um clipe entre duas marcações.

PLAYER E LAYOUT
Mais de 140 controles: modo cinema dividido, sete temas completos, três densidades de visualização, cor ambiente opcional no player, velocidade persistente, volume pela roda do mouse e um mini player.

COMENTÁRIOS E CHAT
Navegação e ordenação de comentários, exportação em JSON ou CSV, bloqueio de usuários no chat, remoção de spam repetido e rants que continuam visíveis depois de expirar.

PRIVACIDADE
O RumbleX não coleta nada. Não há análise, nem configuração remota, nem conta. Suas configurações, seu histórico e seus favoritos ficam no armazenamento local do navegador e nunca saem da máquina. O relatório de privacidade embutido mostra exatamente quais servidores a extensão consegue alcançar e por quê. No Chromium, o acesso fica limitado ao Rumble, às duas CDNs de mídia e às ações opcionais do GitHub. O Firefox também lista os servidores de anúncios exigidos pela API de bloqueio.

Disponível em inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês, italiano e português do Brasil.

fr.name: RumbleX
fr.short_description: Blocage des pubs, téléchargement de vidéos et plus de 140 réglages pour rumble.com. Sans télémétrie.
fr.detailed_description:
RumbleX est une extension open source qui vous rend le contrôle de rumble.com.

BLOCAGE DES PUBLICITÉS
Sept règles réseau déclaratives bloquent les serveurs publicitaires et de pistage de Rumble avant le chargement de la page, complétées par un nettoyage du DOM pour les surcouches de pause et les incitations Premium.

TÉLÉCHARGEMENTS
Enregistrez une vidéo en MP4 direct, convertissez un flux HLS en MP4, ou écrivez le flux de transport brut directement dans le fichier de votre choix. Sélectionnez plusieurs vidéos dans un fil ou exportez un clip entre deux repères.

LECTEUR ET MISE EN PAGE
Plus de 140 réglages : mode cinéma divisé, sept thèmes complets, trois densités d'affichage, couleur ambiante facultative du lecteur, vitesse persistante, volume à la molette et un mini-lecteur.

COMMENTAIRES ET TCHAT
Navigation et tri des commentaires, export en JSON ou CSV, blocage d'utilisateurs du tchat, suppression des messages dupliqués, et des rants qui restent visibles après expiration.

CONFIDENTIALITÉ
RumbleX ne collecte rien. Pas d'analyse, pas de configuration distante, pas de compte. Vos paramètres, votre historique et vos favoris vivent dans le stockage local du navigateur et ne quittent jamais la machine. Le rapport de confidentialité intégré montre exactement quels serveurs l'extension peut atteindre, et pourquoi. Sous Chromium, l'accès se limite à Rumble, à ses deux CDN multimédias et aux actions GitHub facultatives. Firefox répertorie aussi les serveurs publicitaires requis par son API de blocage.

Disponible en anglais, allemand, espagnol, français, italien et portugais du Brésil.

it.name: RumbleX
it.short_description: Blocco pubblicità, download dei video e oltre 140 controlli per rumble.com. Nessuna telemetria.
it.detailed_description:
RumbleX è un'estensione open source che ti restituisce il controllo di rumble.com.

BLOCCO PUBBLICITÀ
Sette regole di rete dichiarative bloccano i server pubblicitari e di tracciamento di Rumble prima che la pagina si carichi, con la pulizia del DOM per le sovrapposizioni in pausa e gli inviti al Premium.

DOWNLOAD
Salva un video come MP4 diretto, converti un flusso HLS in MP4, o scrivi il transport stream grezzo direttamente nel file che scegli. Seleziona più video da qualsiasi feed o esporta una clip fra due marcatori.

LETTORE E LAYOUT
Oltre 140 controlli: modalità cinema divisa, sette temi completi, tre densità di visualizzazione, colore ambiente opzionale del lettore, velocità persistente, volume con la rotella e un mini lettore.

COMMENTI E CHAT
Navigazione e ordinamento dei commenti, esportazione in JSON o CSV, blocco degli utenti in chat, rimozione dello spam ripetuto e rant che restano visibili dopo la scadenza.

PRIVACY
RumbleX non raccoglie nulla. Nessuna analisi, nessuna configurazione remota, nessun account. Le tue impostazioni, la cronologia e i preferiti restano nell'archiviazione locale del browser e non lasciano mai il dispositivo. Il rapporto sulla privacy integrato mostra esattamente quali server l'estensione può raggiungere, e perché. Su Chromium, l'accesso è limitato a Rumble, alle due CDN multimediali e alle azioni GitHub facoltative. Firefox elenca anche i server pubblicitari richiesti dalla sua API di blocco.

Disponibile in inglese, tedesco, spagnolo, francese, italiano e portoghese brasiliano.
